sourceTitle: Mitsubishi Electric service manual OBH872A (MSZ-FS06NA, MSZ-FS09NA, MSZ-FS12NA, MSZ-FS15NA, MSZ-FS18NA), troubleshooting check table 9-4
safetyNote: Indoor and outdoor mini-split units carry line voltage even when the remote is off. Switch off the outdoor disconnect and the breaker before you touch the unit, and do not open either cabinet. Refrigerant, wiring and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
displayPattern: MSZ-FS06NA through MSZ-FS18NA. Left operation-indicator lamp: 2 blinks, then 2.5 seconds off. This is troubleshooting table 9-4, the pattern shown when the fault is first detected. Failure-mode recall uses a different count.
meaning: Indoor coil or room thermistor fault: the sensor is shorted or open. The left lamp blinks twice, then pauses 2.5 seconds.
causes: Indoor coil thermistor short or open
Room temperature thermistor short or open
diySteps: Count two full cycles of the left lamp and write the pattern down, then switch off the breaker and the outdoor disconnect
Do not open the indoor unit. The manual's check is the thermistor characteristic chart, which is a technician measurement
proAdvice: Two blinks on table 9-4 are the indoor sensors. They are not the outdoor thermistors (6 blinks) and not the recall-mode count. Call a licensed HVAC technician.
